generation.prompt:
Create one TRANSPARENT building-sprite atlas, wide landscape 3:2, FOUR columns by TWO rows, eight clearly separated cells. Each cell contains ONE different Noxian civic building, a genuine LOWER CONSTRUCTION STAGE of the corresponding finished architecture in the reference board. Reference board is approved final Noxus town cutouts: left=Imperial Seat, middle=Bastion, right=tall War College. Do not copy the board background or labels. Every sprite must be complete and isolated with transparent empty margins, no terrain rectangle, no text, no guide lines, no overlap between cells. Same low-angle oblique three-quarter front view, deep imperial charcoal basalt, dark red cloth with pale Noxian crest, warm small braziers, classic handpainted Heroes of Might and Magic III 1999 town bitmap aesthetic. Readable at 100-200px native size. No CGI, 3D render, vector or photoreal. Fixed overhead-left warm light. Keep every architectural foundation resting on its own small basalt footing, doors face towards bottom of canvas.
EXACT GRID ORDER:
Top row column1: village hall, very modest one-story Noxian administrative stone hall, one central red banner and broad central arched door, narrow wings, no palace towers.
Top row column2: town hall, two-story larger upgraded version of same hall, extra parapet and side annexes, stronger entrance, two red banners, still much simpler than approved Imperial Seat.
Top row column3: city hall, grand broad three-story almost-complete Imperial Seat, central pediment and two flanking crenellated towers, three red crested banners, less ornament and fewer buttresses than final approved palace.
Top row column4: Fort, simple broad fortified dark stone gateway with two LOW squat square towers, plain crenellations, open gate, modest Noxian banner; lower defensive stage of right reference Bastion.
Bottom row column1: Citadel, broad fortified dark stone gateway with two MEDIUM tall towers, one outer arch and strong battlements, red pennants, clearly larger and more elaborate than Fort but less tall than final approved twin-tower Bastion.
Bottom row column2: magic guild1, single-story square scholarly black basalt lodge with red doorway curtains, one little upper alcove, arcane brazier. Its footprint and central front entry are the roots of the approved tall War College, NOT a little copy of the full tower.
Bottom row column3: magic guild2, two-story scholarly basalt lodge with attached narrow first tower, red trim, central lit entry. Architectural build-up of previous sprite.
Bottom row column4: magic guild3, three-story stout War College with one tall central tower and side lower tower, red vertical banners, battlement roof, same facade motifs as right reference; less tall than completed College. Show complete foundations and intact roof/side walls on every sprite. Make stages visibly distinct genuine painted construction levels, not recolors or scaled duplicates.
generation.method: Exact authored architectural alpha128 area; one-pixel outward border excludes solid body. No bitmap architecture generated by mask code.
